description: The file implements a WebSocket room management class for real-time communication, managing connections, disconnections, broadcasting messages, and tracking participants within rooms identified by (huddle_id, channel). It uses asyncio for concurrency and FastAPI's WebSocket support.

classes.name: ClientInfo
classes.description: Immutable dataclass representing client user information, specifically the user ID.

classes.name: WsRoomManager
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connections for different rooms, allowing clients to connect, disconnect, and broadcast messages within their rooms.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the room manager with a lock and an empty room dictionary.

methods.name: None connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, huddle_id: str, channel: str, user_id: str)
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket, registers it in a specified room with user info.

methods.name: Optional[Tuple[str,str,str]] disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket from all rooms, returning room and user info if found.

methods.name: None broadcast(self, huddle_id: str, channel: str, message: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sends a message to all WebSockets in a specified room.

methods.name: Set[str] participants(self, huddle_id: str, channel: str)
methods.description: Returns a set of user IDs currently connected in a room.

ctags.name: broadcast
ctags.pattern: /^    async def broadcast(self, huddle_id: str, channel: str, message: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (self, huddle_id: str, channel: str, message: Dict[str, Any])

ctags.name: connect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, huddle_id: str, channel: str, user_id: str) ->/
ctags.signature: (self, websocket: WebSocket, huddle_id: str, channel: str, user_id: str)

ctags.name: disconnect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket) -> Optional[Tuple[str, str, str]]:$/

ctags.name: participants
ctags.pattern: /^    async def participants(self, huddle_id: str, channel: str) -> Set[str]:$/
